📊 The No Name Index: all 138 FBS teams

One number for how good each team is right now, built from how teams play, who they've played, and a few things the box score misses. Updated Sunday after games and again Thursday with injury news. Tap a column header to sort. CFP = the playoff committee's latest top 25 ().

# Chg Team CFP Rec Rating Off Rk Def Rk Quality Rk Résumé Rk SOS Rk Road Talent Rk Injuries Coaching Toughness Form TO luck My adj ST Rk Last game
How these rankings work
  • What it answers: who's best right now, not who had the best season.
  • What goes in: how well each team plays on both sides of the ball, who they've beaten and lost to, how tough the schedule has been, roster talent, injuries, coaching, toughness, recent form and turnover luck.
  • Turnover luck: interceptions are partly skill, but fumble bounces mostly aren't. Teams living off lucky turnovers get marked down a little, and unlucky teams get a little back.
  • Margin matters, to a point: winning big counts more than winning close, but running up the score doesn't.
  • Picks: each game's projected score comes from the two teams' ratings, home field and the weather, then gets compared with the Vegas line and total. Picks are re-made every morning and lock at kickoff.
